guide.closed: The guide has ended. You can show it again from {{settings}}, under “{{guide}}”.

say.accept: Read the report. When it made files, open them from “{{files}}” above to check them. If it is good, press this button ({{finish}}) and the task is finished.
say.anotherRepository: To use another repository, open this, choose “{{create}}”, and pick that repository as its working folder.
say.answer: Choosing an answer puts it in the box below. Sending it makes it your answer.
say.answered: Your answer is sent. It takes a moment to reach the AI working on it.
say.answerReady: Your answer is in. Send it with this button to make it your answer.
say.apps: You can also install alpacawork as an app on this computer, or open it from your phone. The steps are in {{settings}}, under “{{apps}}”.
say.end: That is all there is to it. Go on and ask for anything here. You can send as many requests as you like without waiting for the last one to finish.
say.question: It's your turn. Press this row to open its detail, and answer the question.
say.received: The coordinator (the AI that takes your requests) has your request. A task will appear shortly. Press here to open the conversation and read it.
say.result: A report is ready. Press this row and check it in its detail.
say.send: This is the only input. When a label stands at its left end, that is where the message goes.
say.sendAgain: Write what you want done here and send it. It becomes a task in the list.
say.sendReady: Once it's written, send it with this button.
say.stop: To stop the AI, choose “{{stop}}” here.
say.unassigned: No AI has been put on this row's task yet, so it has not started. Open the row and send what you want done from the box below to start it.
say.working: Your request is listed here as a task, one row each. AI takes it from here, and when a question or a report comes for you, it moves to “{{section}}”.

pending.long: A new instruction arrived. Waiting for the owner to give a new report estimate.

timeView.axisAbsent: The time view is not saved on this device. It loads when the connection is back.
timeView.help: Scroll sideways to move through time. Zoom with ctrl (⌘) + wheel, a pinch, or two fingers. Double-click the time scale to see everything. Point at a line (tap on a phone) for details. Keys: + − 0 N; press → on a title to read its lines in turn.

welcome.lead: A place to hand work to a team of AIs.

picture.listed: They're listed. Your turn comes under “{{section}}”
picture.split: The front-desk AI turns it into tasks, places an AI on each and runs them

welcome.title: Welcome to alpacawork
